home.heroEyebrow: Management system built for veterinary clinics
home.heroTitle: Protect every pet's health with confidence
home.heroDesc: Unify appointments, medical records, reminders, and health insights for a smoother care journey every visit.
home.painDesc: When scheduling, records, billing, and inventory are split across paper, spreadsheets, or multiple tools, teams spend more time reconciling and less time caring.
home.pain1Item1: Appointment data is scattered, requiring repeated front-desk confirmation
home.pain1Item2: Follow-up and vaccine reminders are easy to miss
home.pain2Title: Can't find records and test results quickly?
home.pain2Item2: Lab results, photos, and medication logs are hard to consolidate
home.pain3Title: Too much time on billing, stock, and reports?
home.pain3Item1: Month-end revenue and service reports need manual aggregation
home.pain3Item2: Drug and consumable stock is difficult to track in real time
home.workflowTitle: One platform across pre-visit, in-visit, and post-visit workflows
home.workflowDesc: Connect scheduling, care delivery, and follow-up to improve clinical quality and operational efficiency.
home.whyChooseDesc: More than software, PetCare helps clinics build a more stable and efficient operation model.
home.why2: Improve diagnosis and record retrieval efficiency
home.why3: Cut paper-based and manual reporting errors
home.why4: Gain clear visibility into revenue and inventory

BASIC.Tagline: Entry-level operations plan for small veterinary clinics
BASIC.Description: Designed for single-location small clinics, this plan covers core clinic profile setup, pet owner records, pet profiles, appointment scheduling, and basic consultation notes to help teams digitize quickly.

STANDARD.Tagline: Adds HR and access control for general veterinary hospitals
STANDARD.Description: Ideal for clinics with multiple staff members. Includes all Basic capabilities plus HR tools, staff accounts, role permissions, shift scheduling, and basic billing records for more complete operations.

PROFESSIONAL.Tagline: Full operations suite with inpatient, procurement, and inventory support
PROFESSIONAL.Description: Built for mid-to-large veterinary hospitals. Includes all Standard features plus inpatient care, procurement workflows, general inventory management, and advanced reporting for broader clinical and operational coverage.

ENTERPRISE.Tagline: Enterprise-grade operations for multi-branch veterinary groups
ENTERPRISE.Description: Best for veterinary chains, healthcare groups, or brands requiring advanced controls. Includes all Professional features plus multi-branch management, cross-branch data workflows, pharmacy inventory, lot-expiry tracking, and cross-branch stock lookup.

hero.title: Terms of Service
hero.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before purchasing or using this service.

intro.p1: Welcome to PetCare, a veterinary healthcare management platform (the "Service"). To protect your rights, please read the following terms carefully before registering, purchasing, or using the Service. By completing registration, purchase, payment, activation, or actual use, you are deemed to have read, understood, and agreed to all of these terms.
intro.p2: This Service is designed for use by veterinary hospitals, pet clinics, and related pet healthcare organizations to support digital management of appointment scheduling, electronic records, clinical workflows, billing, inventory, reporting, and client care.

s1.title: 1. Service Description
s1.p1: The Service is a digital management platform exclusively for veterinary organizations. The scope of features depends on the plan purchased. Plan names, pricing, duration, features, and applicable targets are as stated on the purchase page, quotation, order, or mutually confirmed plan documents.
s1.starterDesc: Designed for single-location small clinics to establish a basic digital management workflow.
s1.teamDesc: Designed for general veterinary hospitals with multiple staff. Includes core features plus HR, accounts, permissions, and shift scheduling.
s1.businessDesc: Designed for mid-to-large veterinary hospitals. Includes Team Plan features plus inpatient care, procurement, general inventory, and advanced reporting.
s1.scaleDesc: Designed for veterinary chains or brands needing advanced operations. Includes Business Plan features plus multi-branch, cross-branch data, pharmacy inventory, and advanced controls.
s1.highlight: You acknowledge that actual features, pricing, promotions, duration, add-ons, and activation scope are governed by the platform display content at time of purchase, order records, quotation, or mutually confirmed written content.
s1.p2: The platform may modify, add, remove, or rename plan features based on operational planning, system versioning, technical constraints, or service adjustments. Plans for which payment is completed and the subscription is still active will continue as confirmed at time of purchase, unless otherwise agreed.

s2.title: 2. Accounts and Access
s2.p1: Users must provide accurate, complete, and lawful registration information. Users are responsible for safeguarding account credentials and must not share, lend, transfer, or assign their account to any third party.
s2.p2: If credentials are not properly protected and result in data breaches, unauthorized access, abnormal operations, or other damages, the user shall bear sole responsibility.
s2.p3: The platform may provide different numbers of staff accounts, roles, and feature scopes based on the plan. Additional accounts, branches, permissions, or features must be purchased or upgraded as specified by the platform.

s3.title: 3. Data Content and Usage Restrictions
s3.p1: The Service may involve pet owner data, pet profiles, appointment records, consultation records, examination records, medication records, billing records, inventory records, and other clinic operational data.
s3.p2: Users must ensure all data has a lawful source and proper authorization, and must comply with the Personal Data Protection Act, healthcare regulations, and other applicable laws.
s3.p3: Users must not input, upload, or store the following content in the Service:
items: Content that violates laws or public order and morals
Content that infringes copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, or other intellectual property rights
Personally identifiable information obtained or used without authorization
Malicious programs, viruses, trojans, phishing links, or other content that may compromise system security
Data unrelated to the Service purpose that may burden the system or harm third parties

s4.title: 4. Data Retention, Backup, and Security
s4.p1: The platform will maintain system security with reasonable technical and administrative measures, including access control, data backup, system monitoring, and necessary security protections.
s4.p2: However, users should independently preserve important data and regularly back up or export critical records. The platform does not guarantee permanent retention, uninterrupted availability, or that data will never be lost.
s4.p3: During the active service period, users may export or back up data using the platform's provided functions. After service termination, expiry, or account deactivation, the platform may retain data for a reasonable period; upon expiry of that period, the platform may delete or anonymize such data, unless required by law or otherwise agreed.

s5.title: 5. Add-on Services
s5.p1: The platform may offer additional paid add-on services that users may optionally purchase based on clinic needs.
items: Additional staff accounts
Additional branch management features
Advanced report analytics
Custom field configuration
Custom report design
Dedicated onboarding training
Data import and migration services
Custom workflow configuration
SMS, Email, or LINE notification expansion
Cloud storage expansion
Dedicated technical support services
API integration or third-party system integration
s5.p2: Add-on services must be used with the purchased main plan. Not all add-on items are available for all plans.
s5.p3: Once an add-on service is purchased, activated, configured, produced, or delivered, the service is deemed to have begun. Cancellations or refunds are generally not accepted except as required by law, mutually agreed in writing, due to duplicate payment, erroneous charge, or if the platform is responsible for being unable to provide the add-on.

s6.title: 6. Purchase and Payment Terms
s6.p1: The Service uses a fixed-term license model per plan. Plan pricing, original price, promotional pricing, duration, and payment methods are as stated on the purchase page, order, quotation, or mutually agreed terms.
s6.p2: The Service is a digital platform with no physical goods delivery. Upon payment completion, users may obtain access to plan features through the platform's activation process.
s6.p3: Certain features, custom content, data imports, branch settings, report configurations, or system integrations require configuration or production to be completed before activation.
s6.p4: The platform reserves the right to adjust pricing, plan content, features, and promotions. Existing plans for which payment is completed and active will not be affected by price adjustments, unless otherwise agreed.
s6.p5: After the subscription period expires without renewal or upgrade payment, the platform may suspend or terminate that plan's access. Users wishing to continue should renew in accordance with the plan content and pricing announced at that time.

s7.title: 7. Refunds and Termination
s7.p1: Both main plans and add-on services constitute digital content, online services, or customized services.
s7.p2: By agreeing to these terms and completing purchase or payment, you acknowledge that the Service is digital content, online service, or customized service not provided via tangible media, and agree that the platform will begin providing, activating, configuring, or authorizing the relevant service upon payment completion.
s7.p3: Pursuant to Article 19 of the Consumer Protection Act and related regulations, if the Service has begun, activation or customization has been completed, or the user has actually used the Service, the seven-day cooling-off period does not apply, except as otherwise required by mandatory legal provisions.
s7.highlight: Once the Service has been purchased, paid for, activated, or enabled, cancellations, refunds, partial refunds, or pro-rated refunds are generally not accepted, except as required by mandatory legal provisions, mutually agreed in writing, due to duplicate payment, erroneous charge, or where the platform is responsible for being unable to provide the core service.
